dct_alternative_sm: valuation de la toxicité de l’acide perfluorooctanoïque (APFO) à Hyalella azteca et tête-de-boule
dct_creator_sm: Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada.
dct_description_sm:
Ces données contiennent les résultats des tests de toxicité chronique réalisés avec l’acide perfluorooctanoïque (APFO) à Hyalella azteca et tête-de-boule (Pimephales promelas) afin d’établir une concentration cible en eau douce pour le nettoyage des sites industriels.

Citation: Bartlett AJ, De Silva AO, Schissler DM, Hedges AM, Brown LR, Shires K, Miller J, Sullivan C, Spencer C, Parrott JL. 2021. Lethal and sublethal toxicity of perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) in chronic tests with Hyalella azteca (amphipod) and early-life stage tests with Pimephales promelas (fathead minnow). Ecotoxicology and Environmental Safety. 207:111250. doi: 10.1016/j.ecoenv.2020.111250

These data contain the results of chronic toxicity tests with perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) to Hyalella azteca and Fathead minnow (Pimephales promelas) to set a PFOA freshwater target concentration for cleanup of industrial sites.

Citation: Bartlett AJ, De Silva AO, Schissler DM, Hedges AM, Brown LR, Shires K, Miller J, Sullivan C, Spencer C, Parrott JL. 2021. Lethal and sublethal toxicity of perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) in chronic tests with Hyalella azteca (amphipod) and early-life stage tests with Pimephales promelas (fathead minnow). Ecotoxicology and Environmental Safety. 207:111250. doi: 10.1016/j.ecoenv.2020.111250

dct_title_s: Assessing the toxicity of perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) to Hyalella azteca and Fathead minnow
